races.title: StoneX Commodities Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Hard to discount any in a tight-looking handicap. KAMAXOS is interesting in this sort of grade and may add another winner to Charlie Longsdon's recent haul. Maccarellu is potentially well treated if back on song, with Western Cross also appealing at the weights. KAMAXOS (FR) MACCARELLU (FR) WESTERN CROSS (IRE)

races.title: StoneX Southern National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Prolific in handicap hurdles last season, MASK OF ZORRO picked up where he left off when making a successful transition to chasing at Newton Abbot (3¼m) 18 days ago. Totally unexposed at marathon trips and hailing from a stable who continue in rude health, this dual course winner looks a major player again. Jeu d'Opale tackles a much longer trip on return but appeals as being on a good mark, with last year's winner Livin On Luco and hat-trick seeker Paper Mill also shortlisted. MASK OF ZORRO (IRE) JEU D'OPALE (FR) LIVIN ON LUCO (IRE)

races.title: StoneX Bullion Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BASS HUNTER was one of the best British-trained bumper horses last season and judged on his easy win on hurdling debut 4 weeks ago, he's a smart novice in the making. He's very likely to outclass these under a penalty, though expensive point recruit Catchem Black should ensure he doesn't have it all his own way. BASS HUNTER (FR) CATCHEM BLACK (IRE) CASPER CHARLIE (IRE)

races.title: StoneX Payments Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SILVER STATE 's stamina needs to be taken on trust but there's no doubting he's the clear pick on Flat form (useful 4-time winner) and he could well be worth siding with having joined a yard that do particularly well with such types in this discipline. Pass The Buck and Lion In Zion may emerge best of those with prior hurdles experience, whilst James Choice is another interesting recruit from the Flat. SILVER STATE (IRE) PASS THE BUCK (IRE) LION IN ZION (FR)

races.title: John Rogerson Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict: MAJESTIC MOMENT usually goes well at this track, arrives fit and in-form and, back off his last winning mark, is taken to notch up a third course success. Fay Ce Que Voudras arrives in search of a 4-timer and rates the main danger despite not being out since March. Chasing debutants Just Call Me Buzz and What A Dragon are both worthy of interest and any support should be taken very seriously. MAJESTIC MOMENT (IRE) FAY CE QUE VOUDRAS (IRE) JUST CALL ME BUZZ

races.title: Maria's And Aidie's 25th Wedding Anniversary Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Cases can be made for a few of these, but ASTA LA VISTA ran his best race when finishing runner-up at Bangor back in the spring and with this extra distance a possible catalyst for further progress, Tom Britten's new recruit is taken to get off the mark. County Champs has had plenty of goes and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Charles Morin and Black Dakota taken to fight out third. ASTA LA VISTA COUNTY CHAMPS (IRE) CHARLES MORIN
